run_cli_ocr: run the chandra CLI to perform OCR on images and PDFs from input path to output path
build_ocr_batch: build a batch of OCR inference jobs using InferenceManager with vllm or hf method and configurable page range
get_supported_files: get a list of supported image and PDF files from a given directory or single file path
save_merged_output: save merged OCR results as markdown, HTML, metadata JSON, and extracted images to an output directory
test_cli_page_range: test the chandra CLI with a page range option to process only specific pages of a multi-page PDF
